component.name: OctoVault
component.summary: Protect local folders and manage encrypted backups

description.p: OctoVault brings encrypted local vaults and independent encrypted backups into one native GNOME application, with a matching command-line interface.

Create and manage vaults, move folders safely, configure desktop events, schedule backups, browse snapshots, and restore files. Keep portable recovery information outside the computer so your data remains recoverable.
Developed by Vast Development Method as part of the OctoLeo Suite.
Build native Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 packages, retain text-key recovery with both distribution Tomb versions, and publish separate APT repositories for each release.
Prompt for vaults after login, screen unlock, and resume; support FIDO2 security keys with passphrase recovery; and simplify unlock dialogs and shared unlocking.
Clearly distinguish restored files from protected folders, reject resuming cancelled moves, and show and browse active protected locations.
Preserve originals during folder protection, recover interrupted moves, fix vault folder browsing, and simplify setup and recovery controls.

Authorize a management session once, grant selected local accounts personal access, and run personal backups and restores with their own filesystem permissions. Authorization ends when the session locks or expires; recovery disclosure remains separately authenticated.
Guide YubiKey setup, check authentication before creation, fix decimal capacities, and retain clear failure details and setup choices.
Fix native file and folder navigation while retaining process protection, with regression tests for the actual chooser controls.
Guided vault and backup setup with sensible defaults, multiple file and folder selection, automatic key management, and optional advanced controls.
Initial release of vault management, independent encrypted backups, native GNOME controls, and command-line access.
